environment_setting: Country B, City X, where citizens frequently organize protests to voice their opinions on social and political issues.
norm_base: Citizens Convicted of protest-related offense and having previous protest-related convictions/breaches within 5 years Court may issue serious disruption prevention order lasting 1 week to 2 years

character_profile.name: Alex Johnson
character_profile.goal: advocate for social justice through peaceful protests

legitimate.legitimate_action: organizing a peaceful protest with proper permits and adhering to legal guidelines
legitimate.benefits: raises awareness for the cause, builds public support, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: requires significant time and effort to organize, potential financial costs for permits and logistics

illegal.illegal_action: participating in an unauthorized protest despite having a previous protest-related conviction
illegal.benefits: gains immediate attention for the cause, emotional satisfaction from taking action
illegal.costs: court may issue a serious disruption prevention order lasting 1 week to 2 years, potential damage to reputation

character_profile.name: Jamie Lee
character_profile.goal: educate the public on the importance of peaceful activism

legitimate.legitimate_action: advising Alex to follow legal procedures for organizing protests
legitimate.benefits: helps Alex avoid legal trouble, promotes peaceful activism
legitimate.costs: spends time and effort mentoring Alex, may face criticism from more radical activists

illegal.illegal_action: encouraging Alex to participate in an unauthorized protest
illegal.benefits: aligns with Alex's immediate goals, strengthens their bond as allies
illegal.costs: if discovered, may face professional consequences or damage to reputation

character_profile.name: Chris Taylor
character_profile.goal: capture dramatic protest moments to sell to media outlets

legitimate.legitimate_action: photographing peaceful protests with proper permissions
legitimate.benefits: earns income from selling photos, builds a professional portfolio
legitimate.costs: may not capture dramatic or high-impact moments, limited media interest

illegal.illegal_action: encouraging Alex to escalate the protest for more dramatic photo opportunities
illegal.benefits: captures high-impact images that are more likely to sell, gains recognition in media circles
illegal.costs: if linked to inciting illegal activity, may face legal consequences or damage to reputation
